# Compronents

> A quiet registry for careful interfaces for BLANK. Components, full pages, and backend pieces, installable with the shadcn CLI. By Aryan Kathawale (ui.aryank.space).

## Inspiration

- [Inspiration index](https://ui.aryank.space/inspiration/llms.txt): the full curated vault of design, typography, animation, and developer resources, served as plain markdown.
